services.purpose: Prepares the private administrator and API key without Docker access; a separately approved endpoint is still required.

acceptance.description: Authenticate the CLI-file-preseeded admin, create the administrator-equivalent API key once, save privately before readback, and verify the same admin using the key after separate approval for its last-used metadata update.

Disconnected credential preparation is never ready as a manager. Separately approve and verify an existing private mTLS Docker endpoint, its peer/engine identity and host-wide authority before endpoint enrollment.
Restart only this owner and prove saved password/key and endpoint access persist; password-file initialization never resets an existing administrator.
